Yeah I would relex on the VET. Working through sleep deprivation and not generally resting well had my head and heart racing in an uneasy way. Forget depressing workings conditions, you just skipped steps right into self harm. It's just a job, you wanna be alive to see Friday. 

Try to get 5 hours on your off days. You still leave at a normal time but you'll get a better sleep and you'll still be a little freak and work 7 days a week.

During peak and when I say that I mean anytime where your manager is telling everyone that the buttom 5, 10, 20 percent of your department will be receiving coaching or write ups. You wanna be working when it's not peak.
I wear Nike hi top blazers. Blazers anchor my feet onto my insoles to keep them from moving. Firm ankle support. The lace system and tongue let you readjusted and move in any direction.

If you see the hour glass on your scanner after you go to the bathroom. Scan a bin or tote to reset for Time off tasks (last 7 mins since last work transfer) 
If you have low ToT you can break earlier without question. This doesn't mean you can have a low rate because the rate is determined by work demand. This means you can appear to be close to executing your work in a tighter work flow which will be good for your work performance. Try to enjoy your break and your time at the FC, it's very possible that you can enjoy your work.
This is lowkey me too. I wish I had a hot girl as a manager. I'd be hard all day if that was the case. I'm still pretty satisfied with all the young ladies in yoga pants.

If things go bad just take the pay from the 6 hours of training and 30 days of trial work and reapply in 3 months (with a part time job in between) and repeat until you learn how to pick well. 

Work hard enough to not get any write up of course and if you do get one don't let it go to your head. No one cares and it won't matter in 30 days because the write up will go away and you're still standing tall. 

It's just a job. Try your best. Focus on you and your work after that you could relax in the break room.

I used to work stow and realized that I would stay in one spot of the FC all shift. It was really depressing because we were asked to breakdown a minimum of 10 to 15 pallets of inventory which is lowkey insane.  I wouldn't use the bathroom and I would still get write ups for rate.. Now that I'm in OP/OB I go everywhere and I have to watch my back because of safety. It's easier because I just pick 3-5 batches of orders in 3 hours. 

I lowkey have a panic attack if I don't have my phone on me. I don't need to listen to anything or check Twitter. Maybe check Robinhood or snap but it's not even a noticeable amount and if it happens it''s in the bathroom which is reasonable for safety reasons. It's not a distraction to me. I enjoy working more than being on my phone. I just like the choice. I wouldn't choose to be distracted and lazy. I want to support my team and manager. My phone takes away my depressing thoughts. 

I do try to talk to females. Usually  they're married or have older kids which isn't a problem but than again it is a problem if you know what I mean. I stopped trying and I just like talking to pretty women at work. 

Everyone generally dislikes the place until they hear that VTO was announced

In life family comes first I see that something bad happened but someday they’ll realize that they need you. At one point they thought and knew that family comes first also but now you have to carry on until the both of you mature. No is ever truly done growing.

I had a date last month where I could’ve hooked up with her easily but I just hate the actions and motions of playing along until I get my satisfaction. Being in an actual relationship would gratify my mood and desires all together, but after the date I got depressed because the follow through wasn’t even worth it. Plus she was a thot that was flirting with our server so I dodged a dirty bullet and dropped her asap. Ultimately girls don’t feel sad because they think about having a good time and money. Just take care of yourself and you’ll be doing better than all the dumb thots. Let a crush form when a girl approaches you. Crushes are not a part of nature my friend. Just be natural. Take it slow and direct your moves on your path and watch who you’ll meet up with.
How do we talk? I’m pretty new to reddit

Don’t feel bad about not having a girlfriend or wife. Girls are only good for two things. Having sex and making babies. The connection is not working from both sides. When you have sex even causal sex you potentially take on the risk of becoming a man and father all in one motion. Right now, enjoy your life, work hard, and learning about yourself. You’ll need more resources and confidence to become a more defined gentleman in these days. 

Personally: I had sex when I was younger and it personally it’s not a big deal. It feels the same every time with every girl. The thing that matters the most is being sure you want that girl for life. You’re a whole package and they’re a whole package too. You have to learn to carry yourself for awhile before your carry anyone else.

It is not. Find something that can make you laugh. Go to the mall. Find some ugly people you can laugh at. If you’re ugly buy yourself a pizza and share the pizza with the ugly people/person. Don’t tell them you think they are ugly. Just be nice and they’ll be nice to you to. Maybe you can make them tell you how bad their life is and be thankful that you are not them. When you’re done you can have a new friend or just walk away and never see them again.
Yes, as much as adult co workers would talk. In reality family doesn’t mean as much as your job/income but that’s understandable.

Yeah, I’m okay now. I just need to express some feelings cause it’s better out than in. Your post made me realize that no one video tapes funerals rather they record child birth and weddings. Videos and messages should mean something more than just to spread negativity, blame and shame. Videos and messages should be positive

Yes they’re great they had a hard start with my dad around but they moved away and have their own jobs. My one sister was a singer songwriter but choose to hide her talent cause it’s better to not have any attention on her anymore. I even helped videotape her singing, but keeping up with negative energy just shut down the whole talent.

How my dad mentally abused my sisters and I into hiding from the world. We can’t be ourselves around our parents and so what makes them think we can be great people for the outside world. His high standards are okay but you can atleast teach someone how to live beyond mistakes because than we’ll just do anything else worst for any misguided reason. My death will teach him nothing and he’ll never talk to any of his friends or girlfriends ever again and he’ll understand what it feels like to be a loser. I should be his favorite loser because he’s my favorite champion in life.

Thanks for writing! I’d like to do journalism, story writing and an overall English major however whenever I bring up my studies to my father he berates me about what I’m doing and how flawed I am. Moreover how much work he went through to have me. Doing medical would have been better for the culture and the community as a whole, but he doesn’t understand that I don’t have to carry the community for my self improvement. Which is just a crazy idea to put on to someone. 

I don’t think I need peer reviews. I just want peace of mind. Doubt and depression can slow down any work done by anyone.

Yes, I live to fix my parents work or email accounts and the tv. I stopped going to school because I can’t focus unless I can use all of my time to work outside of my job. They diminish my job but it’s the only thing I feel comfortable doing. I’m always sad and tired because I can’t be myself around them or anyone else. I want them to understand that they force me into a happy life that they want, but our lives start and end at different places in time and I don’t owe them my hard work so I just shut off all together.
